paired_valid_ND_diagnostic.scope: Additional paired-valid ND diagnostic; primary ratio definitions are unchanged.

supplemental_evaluator_scope: SVM/MLOPT bank/role I/O wrapper separately sealed after the15-role model freeze; frozen models and decision rules were retained.
ratio_definition: Returned original gross profit / certified original optimum, averaged over primary valid returns (N).
recovery_denominator: All360 shared objectives for every role, including invalid and late returns.
interpretation: Continued ND uses the fixed update2000 checkpoint. Any reduction of the Ours gap is retained. Timing does not establish a solve speedup.
